shots.detail_en: HOOK: resume-trading opening bell; on the giant flip board Lianhua Network rockets a huge bullish candle straight into limit-up, the whole screen saturated red
shots.sub: 散户群（狂呼）：「涨停！蚂蚁真把山搬翻了！」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Mancang bounces in place hugging a pager, his flower shirt flapping like a flag
shots.sub: 满仓：「我全仓！我今天要再加一层仓——满仓加满，双倍满仓！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong stares at the limit-up board, brows locked; Hongli follows his gaze
shots.sub: 长虹：「他输得太快了。这不是他的棋。」红利：「你的意思是——」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Changhong's finger taps three times on the limit-up price
shots.sub: 长虹：「这根阳线太乖了。乖得像他亲手画上去的。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: After-close counting; Hongli's ledger spread open, Mancang giggling while counting cash
shots.sub: 红利：「等等。今天拉涨停的买单——全部来自同一个席位。是他自己的账户。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli's fingertip pinned on the four words XIONG-SYSTEM SEAT in the ledger
shots.sub: 红利：「他自己的钱，把自己骂下来的票，又拉了回去。这在账上只有一个解释——」长虹：「请客。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: A long queue at the cash-out window, everyone grinning ear to ear
shots.sub: 散户乙：「熊爷也有看走眼的一天！走，吃顿好的去！」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Changhong stands on a desk — and for the first time nobody looks up at him; the crowd is too busy celebrating
shots.sub: 长虹：「各位，糖是好糖——但发糖的人姓什么，你们忘了？」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE BEAT, three rapid cuts: the cash-out window counter / banknotes stuffed into shirt pockets / Changhong's face sinking amid the crowd's laughter
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）：「散户最忠诚的时刻，是他们开始觉得自己聪明的时候。这句话，是熊天成的。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Hongli yanks Mancang back from the cash-out queue, holding his blocked order slip
shots.sub: 红利：「加仓单我扣下了。这波利润全是他印的糖纸——钱进了口袋，名字就进了他的名单。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mancang glances between the blocked order in Hongli's hand and the red board
shots.sub: 满仓：「可是……它还在涨啊。」长虹：「钩上的肉，也还在涨。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Lianhua Tower top floor; Xiong Tiancheng calmly prunes a bonsai while watching his own defeat on the board
shots.sub: 熊：「我从来没有做错过任何事。让他们赢一场，是我这次唯一没把握做对的事——所以我把它做对了。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei at the floor-to-ceiling window; on his screen an account map sprouts red dots layer by layer
shots.sub: 熊伟：「兑现的账户，全部浮出水面。2997个。蚂蚁名单，收网完成。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Screen corner: three anonymous accounts without red dots, code name a single character LU
shots.sub: 熊伟：「还差三个。三个匿名户，共用一个委托习惯——每天收盘前十分钟，精确到秒。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: In the hall, retail investor A leads a small mob surrounding Changhong
shots.sub: 散户甲：「陆先生，昨天你叫我们别卖，今天你又叫我们别买——你到底是帮我们，还是怕我们赚太多？」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Changhong scans the encircling faces — the very faces he pulled back from panic yesterday
shots.sub: 长虹（低）：「我救的是你们的钱，不是你们的贪。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The crowd disperses grumbling, someone spits over a shoulder; Mancang caught in the middle, face burning red
shots.sub: 散户丙：「等他带我们亏一次，就知道了！」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: The emptied hall; Hongli and Changhong stand before the little mountain of pagers
shots.sub: 红利：「同盟第一天赢钱，散了一半的人心。」长虹：「这不是散。这是他把糖，发到了每个人心里最软的地方。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng puts down the scissors and murmurs to the prayer beads on his wrist
shots.sub: 熊：「散户的心，从来不用抢——排队送上门的东西，我只负责开一下门。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CLIFF: on Xiong Wei's screen two of the three LU accounts turn red; the third cursor rotates slowly and locks onto a counter clerk's employee number
shots.sub: 熊伟（画外）：「第三个户……开在联华柜台的员工名下。有意思。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「糖的下面，是刀。刀尖先指谁？」
shots.card: 糖的下面，是刀。刀尖先指谁？
